answer: Probation escrow with elder spot-checks: each new wallet locks 8 POA for 30 epochs, and every epoch a random elder, picked by the zenith of the latest block hash, asks it one fresh question. An honest user locks 8 POA and answers 30 times; 1,000 fakes lock 8,000 POA and need 30,000 distinct answers. Copying one answer across wallets is flagged as duplicate, so each flagged wallet forfeits 50% and 1,000 fakes lose 4,000 POA. Elders who falsely accuse lose a 2 POA stake; the limit is that a tundra-patient attacker with an orchard of capital can still pay.
